title: Datumesh find result (one entry of a find)
description: SPEC.md 9.6 and 16.8, since the classes round (C2). One result of a mesh's find: its members are the mesh's, and only publisher, source and facets are checked here (publisher is the host of fn, checked by the procedure, E_DESCRIBE). Other members are the mesh's and are not constrained.

source.description: A relayed function's source, as describe gives it (16.8).
